name: Truncated Dynamic Low-pass Filter
definition: A frequency masking strategy for positional encoding in NeRF-based pose optimization that prevents invalid RGB inference at early stages by starting the frequency threshold at a non-zero value, unlike standard dynamic low-pass filters which start from zero.
summary: The Truncated Dynamic Low-pass Filter prevents NeRF pose estimation from converging to local optima by initializing frequency masking at a non-zero value, ensuring valid color data from the start.
